subject.title: feat(github-copilot): support GitHub Enterprise data-residency Copilot auth

question: Should the bundled github-copilot provider accept allowlisted github.com and single-label *.ghe.com host routing through COPILOT_GITHUB_DOMAIN and githubDomain, or should GHE Copilot remain outside core until a generic seam exists?
rationale: The implementation looks coherent, but the permanent product/security contract decides where OAuth and Copilot tokens may be sent and whether this provider-specific SDK/config surface belongs in bundled OpenClaw.

options.title: Accept narrow bundled routing
options.body: Approve this PR's allowlisted provider-owned GHE routing, domain-scoped cache, guided auth choice, docs, and tests as the supported path for the existing github-copilot provider.

options.title: Require generic seam first
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers define a reusable provider-host routing contract and then adapt the Copilot implementation to that seam.

options.title: Route to plugin scope
options.body: Reject bundled-provider GHE routing and close this PR plus the linked issue with direction to implement a separate plugin/ClawHub provider.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow bundled routing
recommendation.body: Approve this PR's allowlisted provider-owned GHE routing, domain-scoped cache, guided auth choice, docs, and tests as the supported path for the existing github-copilot provider.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is the strongest recent current-main signal across the Copilot provider/auth files that the PR changes.
